about: Changes to djazair.dev worth telling readers about, newest first. Each data release is added to the changelog automatically from data/derived/*/manifest.json; list here only other changes (new pages, changed formulas). date: YYYY-MM-DD, or null until the change is live. Text is Markdown.

entries.en: **Index v1.** First public release: the scorecard, peers, trends, languages, topics, collaboration and GitHub’s GDC26 ranking, with the methodology and every table as CSV and JSON.
entries.ar: **المؤشر، النسخة 1.** أول إصدار عام: بطاقة الأداء والنظراء والاتجاهات واللغات والمواضيع والتعاون وتصنيف GitHub في GDC26، مع المنهجية وكل جدول بصيغتي CSV وJSON.
